corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The move articulates a disciplined evidentiary standard centered on reliable discrimination, specificity, independent confirmation, and bias reduction, while carefully describing repeatability and falsifiability as ideal features rather than exceptionless requirements. Principal limitation: It does not separately test each explanatory virtue invoked for the divine account, and some metaphysical evidence may remain rationally relevant despite lacking experimental repetition or direct causal isolation. Live burden: The standard must explain how philosophical and historical evidence can receive appropriate weight, identify which divine predictions are sufficiently specific, and show why the offered transcendental considerations fail comparatively rather than merely failing laboratory ideals. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precise qualification, excellent burden relevance, coherent hypothesis-sensitive reasoning, and charitable allowance for nonexperimental evidence, with only limited incompleteness in its application to every constructive claim.

corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The move directly challenges the comparative structure of the theistic abduction and memorably distinguishes reasonable ordinary inference from confidence in extraordinary candidates when the relevant possibility space, priors, and alternatives are poorly understood. Principal limitation: Its language about unreliability is broader than the supporting analogy warrants, because abduction can responsibly rank known explanations without possessing an exhaustive candidate list when background frequencies and comparative expectations are independently justified. Live burden: The objection must specify how incomplete the candidate set is, which omitted rivals are genuinely live, and why uncertainty about unknown possibilities materially weakens this particular divine comparison rather than every abductive inference. Locked score: The strong band reflects clear responsiveness, good calibration through the ordinary-case concession, and serious underdetermination pressure, moderated by an imprecise completeness threshold and no fully developed alternative account.
